title: Carter 1.0 Quality Review Result
description: Strict advisory quality-review result produced by Carter 1.0 after Dataset Forge deterministic validation.

summary.description: Concise advisory summary of overall dataset quality.

issue_id.description: Review-local issue identifier. It is not a canonical Dataset Forge artifact identifier.

x-dataset-forge-validation-rules: Every affected_record_ref must be verified by Dataset Forge against the reviewable record set supplied to Carter.
Every non-null affected_field must exist in the approved DatasetSpec.
Unknown record refs invalidate the review result.
Unknown field names invalidate the affected-field reference.

rules: If the application reports that the single revision budget has already been used, revise_recommended must not trigger another revision.
Dataset Forge may normalize the workflow decision to accept-with-warnings after revision budget exhaustion.
The model never increases the revision count.
No review result may authorize a second model-authored revision.
issues may be empty when the dataset has no meaningful advisory problems.
If issues is empty, recommendation must be accept.
Do not invent low-value issues merely to populate the report.
This review result does not replace schema validation.
This review result does not replace source-reference authorization.
This review result does not replace evidence verification.
This review result does not replace grounding validation.
This review result does not replace security validation.
This review result does not establish package readiness.
The same result schema applies to RunPod and LM Studio.
Do not add provider-specific issue fields.
Do not expose provider job IDs.
Review semantics remain identical across providers.

examples.summary: The candidate dataset is clear, relevant, and sufficiently diverse. One minor wording issue does not materially reduce usefulness.

issues.description: The question is slightly more verbose than comparable records.
issues.recommended_correction: Shorten the wording while preserving the same source-supported concept.

examples.summary: A substantial portion of the dataset asks semantically equivalent questions with only minor wording changes, reducing training diversity.

issues.description: These records test essentially the same regression-testing definition using cosmetic rewording.
issues.recommended_correction: Replace redundant records with source-grounded examples covering distinct regression-testing concepts or applications.
